action.objective: Verify knight capture on e5, resolving the attack on the queen and winning a pawn, against Black's best reply.
action.rationale: Broad depth-2 search suggested d3e5 at 261, exact but shallow; queen on d2 is attacked and the knight on d3 is en prise to a3d3 ideas. d3e5 grabs e5, hits g6 bishop, and frees the queen. Single-candidate verification required before commit.
